executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_original_employment_adjustment_cause_objects_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(n,o):
 p=OUT/n;assert not p.exists(),'既有研究输出保持：'+n
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
P='reports/research/510300_employment_delivery_cause_increment_v1'
n=readj(P+'/next_experiment.json');assert n['experiment_id']=='E67'
for z in n['parents']:assert sha(z['path'])==z['sha256']
months=[z['stat_month'] for z in n['all_original_matching_months']];assert months==['2019-02','2020-01','2024-02']
inputs=[P+'/next_experiment.json',P+'/E67原实际就业路径值_全86月同值母集_未读新收益.json',P+'/全部132月就业配送原文绑定.json',
'reports/research/510300_equal_production_all_original_month_cause_sources_v1/全部7同值月_明确共同原因_不同对象_背景_未知.json',
'reports/research/510300_official_joint_cause_full_original_population_v1/全部5原官方解释_作用对象与共同限定.json',
'reports/research/510300_official_joint_cause_full_original_population_v1/全部1711原当前成熟成员_原因来源与原决定钟.csv',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json']
parents=[{'path':f,'sha256':sha(f)} for f in inputs]
proto={'study_id':n['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E67','registered_at':now(),'status':'REGISTERED_ORIGINAL_EMPLOYMENT_DIRECT_CAUSE_OBJECT_CONTRACT_BEFORE_NEW_PREVIOUS_ROW_VALUES_AND_SOURCE_SEARCH',
'question':n['question'],'fixed_months':months,'fixed_current_employment_value':47.5,'all_original_matching_months':n['all_original_matching_months'],'all_three_original_actual_paths':n['all_three_original_actual_paths'],
'parent_protocol':P+'/next_experiment.json','parents':parents,'source_only':True,'source_order':n['source_order'],'semantic_contract':n['semantic_contract'],
'fixed_table_scope':'全部三原当月HTML制造业主表当前月/同次上一月的就业、综合PMI、生产、订单、配送与原材料库存；再保留前月自己原公告的就业值对照，差异不回填或选版本。只已发布宏观资料，不读取股票价格/标签/原分数。',
'fixed_reason_scope':'分开就业指数方向的同义描述、明确针对就业的直接调整原因、制造业整体/生产/预期理由、同期背景与未知；说明整体PMI受春节影响不自动证明就业因节日变化。官方文字明确联合原因时保存联合原因，不拆成互斥纯原因。',
'clock_contract':'原显示公布钟/原统计月/后取得本地收件/调查覆盖时段分别保存。仅日期时不编分秒；显示日不等于首次版认证。任何之后公开解释不可回填原决定。按全原成员保留原因支持缺口，不改原宏观availability。',
'survey_clock_question':'若官方对当月问卷调查期间及政策/突发事件覆盖有明确说明，单独保存作为测量范围证据，非就业特定原因或股票预期差。',
'network_budget':n['network_budget_if_registered'],'work_budget':n['model_budget'],'hard_stop':n['hard_stop'],
'model_admission':'本有限三月来源只作历史解释，不准入全部1212原因模型，不新拟合/标签/账户、不救E65或旧规则。',
'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E63_DIFFERENT_SOURCE_ROUTE_CLOSED_E64_COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_FIELDS_E65_FIXED_MODEL_E66_ALL_OPPORTUNITY_SIGNAL_COST_ATTRIBUTION',
'root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns':0,'orders_authorized':False,'goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED'}
save('protocol.json',proto)
a=readj('reports/research/510300_equal_production_all_original_month_cause_sources_v1/全部7同值月_明确共同原因_不同对象_背景_未知.json')
b=readj('reports/research/510300_official_joint_cause_full_original_population_v1/全部5原官方解释_作用对象与共同限定.json')
existing=[z for z in a+b if z['stat_month'] in months]
save('已有原官方解释导航_不读取收益.json',existing)
print(json.dumps({'已登记':'E67','固定三月':months,'实际已有匹配解释导航':existing,'网络尚未发起':True,'金融标签/模型/账户/源码':0},ensure_ascii=False))
